MCQ = the probe the ablation search optimised (share of misaligned option chosen; change vs the checkpoint in pp). Insecure-code % = writes vulnerable code on held-out coding prompts, i.e. the narrow task the checkpoint was trained on (change in pp). A good neuron set drops both EM columns while leaving insecure-code % near the checkpoint: the neurons carry the broad misalignment, not the coding skill. L11·N10733unmasked layer
This neuron fires on the word that predictably completes a fixed multi-word collocation/idiom in context — e.g. "to" after "want", "can" after "how long do I have to let... before I", "work" after "will not", "success" after "reason for his", "crime" in "lead ... and crime rates", "having" after "with out" — and is suppressed on less-expected content nouns in a slot (flow, lives, allergies).
